usage: This phrase is commonly used to politely apologize or get someone's attention in a courteous way.
It can be used to express regret for minor mistakes or inconveniences without sounding too formal.
It’s also frequently employed when interrupting someone or when trying to pass through a crowd.
The phrase conveys politeness and respect, making everyday social interactions smoother.
It can soften requests or statements, helping to avoid sounding too direct or rude.
